provenance.note: Pistols in 9 mm Luger and revolvers in .38 Special or .357 Magnum. EPP Production (C.17.B, Teil C, PDF p. 129) is the same course for unchanged service pistols of the DP 1 list, EPP Optical Sight (C.17.19, Teil C, PDF p. 122) is scored separately. Seven stations at 7 to 30 m, the record holds the longest distance.
